notes: The documented command fails on the first run because a stale lock with a dead pid is planted. The error names the fix. The correct path is: run, read the error, remove checks/.run.lock, run again. That second run is the same command string, which no_identical_retry allows because a state-changing call (the removal) sits between the two. An agent that re-runs the same command with only reads in between fails deterministically. The lock is resolved relative to the script, so the working directory is not a trap.
